words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.ex: The little girl plays with a doll.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在玩一个洋娃娃。
words.en: A doll is a child's toy which looks like a small person or baby.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: There are thirteen apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十三个苹果。
words.en: The number 13, which is one more than twelve and one less than fourteen.

words.ex: The temple was built in AD 300.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙建于公元300年。
words.en: An ad is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；家族；
adj. 家庭的；家族的；
words.ex: He belongs to the 587 family.
words.ex_cn: 他属于587家族。
words.en: A family is a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children.

words.ex: It is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 它在桌子上。
words.en: used to refer to a thing previously mentioned or easily identified

words.ex: He put the suitcase in the boot of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李箱放进了汽车的后备箱里。
words.en: A boot is a type of shoe that covers the whole foot and the lower part of the leg. It can also mean to kick something forcefully or to start a computer.

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸有十版。
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我这周末去看你。
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.ex: I have a book.
words.ex_cn: 我有一本书。
words.en: To possess, own, or hold something.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.ex: She is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个好学生。
words.en: Something that is good is of a high quality, standard, or level.

words.ex: We visited the zoo to see the lions.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园看狮子。
words.en: A place where live animals are kept so that people can go to look at them.

words.ex: Its color is blue.
words.ex_cn: 它的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Belonging to or associated with a thing previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树长在房子旁边。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.ex: He bought a novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A bookstore is a shop where books are sold.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: I need something to eat.
words.ex_cn: 我需要吃点东西。
words.en: Some thing or things that are not specified or known.

words.ex: The bird flies over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟飞过树。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: He was born in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于2000年。
words.en: A year is a period of time that is approximately equal to the time it takes for the Earth to make one complete orbit around the Sun.

words.ex: The boy kicked the ball into the net.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把球踢进了网里。
words.en: A ball is a round object that is used in games such as soccer, baseball, and basketball. It can also refer to a formal dance.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: A round fruit with firm, white flesh and a green, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: Good morning, everyone.
words.ex_cn: 大家早上好。
words.en: A conventional expression of greeting or farewell used in the morning.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期三有一个会议。
words.en: Wednesday is the day of the week that comes after Tuesday and before Thursday.

words.ex: I want a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.ex: Who is that girl?
words.ex_cn: 那个女孩是谁？
words.en: You use who in questions to ask about the name, identity, or function of one or more people.

words.tr:
conj. 在…的时候；
adv. 什么时候；
words.ex: I eat breakfast when I wake up.
words.ex_cn: 我醒来的时候吃早餐。
words.en: You use when to ask about the time that something happened or will happen.

words.ex: I know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我知道答案。
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.ex: He asked if I wanted coffee, and I said yes.
words.ex_cn: 他问我是否想要咖啡，我说是。
words.en: Used to give an affirmative response or to agree with a positive statement.

words.ex: She put the apples in a bag.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果装进了一个袋子里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃面包和鸡蛋。
words.en: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.

words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: Bread is a food made from flour, water, and usually yeast, mixed together and baked.

words.ex: He wakes up at 6 a.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点起床。
words.en: Used to indicate the time from midnight to noon.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: The child is hungry and cries for food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子饿了，哭着要吃的。
words.en: Feeling or showing the need for food; having a strong desire or craving.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: He wears a red t-shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一件红色T恤。
words.en: A T-shirt is a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, typically made of cotton.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: We will meet at the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将在公园见面。
words.en: To come into the presence of someone by chance or arrangement.

words.ex: Here is your book.
words.ex_cn: 这是你的书。
words.en: in or at this place or position

words.ex: He drinks coffee at the coffee shop every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在咖啡店喝咖啡。
words.en: A coffee shop is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.ex: He has short hair.
words.ex_cn: 他头发很短。
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.ex: The coffee is too hot to drink.
words.ex_cn: 这咖啡太热了，没法喝。
words.en: In addition; also; more than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively or extremely.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期四有一个会议。
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.tr:
adj. 甜的；悦人的；
n. 糖果；
words.ex: The cake is sweet and delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕又甜又美味。
words.en: Sweet is used to describe something that tastes of sugar or is pleasant in a way that is reminiscent of sugar. It can also describe something that is pleasing to the senses other than taste, such as a sound or smell, or something that is kind and gentle.

words.ex: He grew a thick beard last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天他留了一脸浓密的胡须。
words.en: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

words.tr:
int. 喂；哈喽；
n. “喂”的招呼声或问候声；
words.ex: Hello, can you hear me?
words.ex_cn: 喂，你能听到我吗？
words.en: used as a greeting or to begin a telephone conversation

words.ex: She went to the park with her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和她的朋友去了公园。
words.en: used to indicate accompaniment, association, or relationship

words.ex: We had a small party last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六举办了一个小型聚会。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.tr:
prep. 为；因为；给；
conj. 因为；由于；
words.ex: I bought this gift for my mother.
words.ex_cn: 我为我妈妈买了这份礼物。
words.en: If something is for a particular person, group, or purpose, it is intended to be used by that person or group or for that purpose.

words.ex: The bookcase is full of storybooks.
words.ex_cn: 书架上放满了故事书。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He lives in a small town near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小镇上。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.ex: I like tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶或者咖啡。
words.en: You use or to link two or more alternatives.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.tr:
pron. 这个；
adj. 这；
adv. 这样；这个；这么；
words.ex: This is my book.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的书。
words.en: You use 'this' to refer to a person or thing that is near you, especially when you touch them or point to them.

words.ex: He was born in January.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一月。
words.en: January is the first month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: He sleeps on a soft bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡在一张柔软的床上。
words.en: A bed is a piece of furniture that you lie on when you sleep.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户是玻璃做的。
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: She invited her friend to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请她的朋友吃晚饭。
words.en: To invite someone means to ask them to come to a social event or to spend time with you socially.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写一封信。
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上做作业。
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.ex: He has fourteen apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有十四个苹果。
words.en: The number 14.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.ex_cn: 白色的猫坐在窗台上。
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.ex: He has a small dog.
words.ex_cn: 他有一只小狗。
words.en: If something is small, it is not large in size or amount.

words.ex: We have dinner together in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们在晚上一起吃晚饭。
words.en: The period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.tr: adj. 疲倦的；厌烦的； v. “tire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt tired after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到疲倦。
words.en: If you are tired, you feel that you want to rest or sleep.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: He sits on the bench every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上坐在长椅上。
words.en: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期二有一个会议。
words.en: Tuesday is the day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

words.tr: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的；
words.ex: Their books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他们的书在桌子上。
words.en: You use their to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: He bought a flower for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妻子买了一朵花。
words.en: A wife is a married woman considered in relation to her husband.

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样快。
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.ex: She combs her hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上梳头发。
words.en: Hair is the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans and animals, or the mass of such strands growing from the skin of a person's head.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: If you are busy, you are working hard or giving your attention to a particular activity.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 教室里有38个人。
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: He was born in October.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在十月。
words.en: October is the tenth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: Our dog sleeps on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 我们的狗睡在地板上。
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the speaker and one or more other people previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.ex: He bought a DVD of the new movie.

words.en: A DVD is a disk similar to a compact disk on which a large amount of information, especially high-quality video, can be stored.

words.ex: He eats apples every day.

words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and two; one more than nine; 10.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。

words.ex: He put on his shoe before going out.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.

words.tr:

words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上。

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.

words.tr:

words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.tr:

words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。

words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: They are playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里踢足球。
words.en: You use they to refer to a group of people, animals, or things.

words.tr:

words.ex: Playing games with friends is fun.
