words.ex: He hunts deer in the forest every autumn.
words.ex_cn: 他每年秋天在森林里打猎。
words.en: To hunt means to chase and try to catch or kill animals for food or sport.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: The comet shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.tr: adv. 否则；在其他方面；除此之外；
words.ex: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会迟到的。
words.en: in circumstances different from those present or considered; or else

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.ex: The two countries formed a union to strengthen trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家组成了一个联盟以加强贸易。
words.en: An organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests; the act of joining two or more things together.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.tr:
adj. 古老的；
n. 古董；
words.ex: He bought an antique chair from the old market.
words.ex_cn: 他从旧市场买了一把古老的椅子。
words.en: Something that is antique is old and often valuable because it is rare or well made.

words.tr: phrase. 唱片骑师；指在电台、夜店或派对中播放和混音音乐的人
words.ex: He is a disc jockey at a radio station.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家广播电台当唱片骑师。
words.en: A disc jockey is a person who introduces and plays recorded music on the radio or at a club or party.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: He shouted loudly to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他大声喊叫以引起注意。
words.en: In a way that produces or is capable of producing much noise; not quietly.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: He learned a new phrase in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一个新的西班牙语短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了学校。
words.en: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: Their marriage lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的婚姻持续了二十年。
words.en: The legally or formally recognized union of two people as partners in a personal relationship.

words.ex: The concert was terrific!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something or someone as terrific, you are very pleased with them or very impressed by them.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.ex: He wrote a short paragraph about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段关于他假期的短文。
words.en: A paragraph is a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph typically starts on a new line.

words.ex: He was seriously injured in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中严重受伤。
words.en: In a serious manner; not lightly or casually.

words.tr: adj. 口头的；口语的； v. 讲话；发言；“speak”的过去分词；
words.ex: He gave a spoken presentation instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他做了口头报告，而不是书面报告。
words.en: relating to speech; using speech rather than writing

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.ex: He beat his competitor in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: A competitor is a person, team, or company that is competing against others, especially in business or sports.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: He took a deep breath before jumping.
words.ex_cn: 他跳之前深吸了一口气。
words.en: The air taken into or expelled from the lungs.

words.ex: He felt disappointment when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 当他考试没及格时，他感到失望。
words.en: A feeling of sadness or displeasure caused by the nonfulfillment of one's hopes or expectations.

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.ex: He accidentally dropped his phone on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心把手机掉在地上了。
words.en: If something happens accidentally, it happens by chance or without being planned.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.ex: The room has air conditioning to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有空调来保持凉爽。
words.en: Air conditioning is a system or process that controls the temperature, humidity, and sometimes the purity of the air in a building or vehicle.

words.ex: The donkey carries water on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这头驴在山上驮水。
words.en: A donkey is a four-legged animal related to the horse, but smaller and with longer ears. Donkeys are often used for carrying or pulling things, especially in parts of the world where there are no cars or trucks.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.tr:
adj. 公众的；
n. 公众；公共场所；
words.ex: The park is open to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对公众开放。
words.en: Relating to or involving people in general, rather than being limited to a particular group of people.

words.tr: adj. 五彩缤纷的；丰富多彩的；
words.ex: The children painted a colorful picture of the rainbow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们画了一幅五彩缤纷的彩虹画。
words.en: Something that is colorful has bright colors or a lot of different colors.

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.tr:
n. 意义；感知；理解力；知觉；
v. 感觉到；觉察出；意识到；
words.ex: The story has no sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事没有意义。
words.en: A sense is a feeling or awareness about something, or a physical ability such as sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.ex: He put the cup on a saucer.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个茶托上。
words.en: A small shallow dish, typically circular, on which a cup is placed.

words.tr: n. 女售货员；女营业员；
words.ex: The saleswoman helped me choose a dress.
words.ex_cn: 女售货员帮我挑选了一条裙子。
words.en: A saleswoman is a woman whose job is to sell products or services in a store or directly to customers.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.ex: He is a successful businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成功的商人。
words.en: Achieving the results wanted or hoped for.

words.tr: v. 恢复；重新获得；复原；
words.ex: He will recover from the illness soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会从疾病中恢复。
words.en: If you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again. If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back.

words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: He eats spinach every day for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐都吃菠菜。
words.en: Spinach is a leafy green vegetable that is high in iron and vitamins, often eaten cooked or raw in salads.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: He wiped sweat from his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他擦去了额头上的汗水。
words.en: The part of the face above the eyebrows and below the hairline.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.tr: adv. 部分地；在一定程度上；
words.ex: The cake is partly eaten.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕被部分吃掉了。
words.en: To some extent but not completely.

words.ex: This company makes a new product every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会推出一种新产品。
words.en: A product is something that is produced and sold in large quantities, often as a result of a manufacturing process.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.ex: He wears a warm pullover in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件厚毛衣。
words.en: A pullover is a piece of clothing that is made of wool or cotton and is worn on the upper part of the body. It is put on by pulling it over the head.

words.ex: The answer is incorrect.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是不正确的。
words.en: If something is incorrect, it is not accurate or true.

words.tr: adj. 难以忘怀的；令人难忘的
words.ex: That summer was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 那个夏天令人难忘。
words.en: If you describe something as unforgettable, you mean that it is, for example, extremely beautiful, enjoyable, or unusual, so that you remember it for a long time. If you describe someone as unforgettable, you mean that they are, for example, extremely interesting, unusual, or attractive, so that you remember them for a long time.

words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr: adv. 令人惊讶地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: Surprisingly, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 令人惊讶的是，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: In a manner that causes surprise because it is unexpected or unusual.

words.ex: She typically arrives early for class.
words.ex_cn: 她往往很早就到课。
words.en: You use typically to say that something usually happens in the way that you are describing.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.ex: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从火中救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is brave is willing to do things which are dangerous, and does not show fear in difficult or dangerous situations.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.ex: He walked toward the door.
words.ex_cn: 他朝门走去。
words.en: In the direction of; in relation to; near to; for the purpose of.

words.tr: n. 惊险小说（或戏剧、电影）；
words.ex: He loves watching thriller movies at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚上看惊险电影。
words.en: A thriller is a book, film, or play that tells an exciting story about something such as criminal activities or spying.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.ex: He gave the exact time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了会议的确切时间。
words.en: If you describe something as exact, you mean that it is precise and accurate in all its details.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.ex: The global climate conference was held in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 全球气候大会在巴黎举行。
words.en: A conference is a meeting of people who share the same interests or profession.

words.tr: adj. 失望的；沮丧的； v. “disappoint”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was disappointed when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格时感到很失望。
words.en: If you are disappointed, you are sad because something has not happened or because something is not as good as you had hoped.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.ex: She sewed a button on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗纽扣缝在了外套上。
words.en: A button is a small, usually round object that you press to operate a device or a machine, or a small, round object that you fasten to clothing to keep it closed.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.tr:
v. 脱衣服
n. 裸体
words.ex: He undressed before taking a shower.
words.ex_cn: 他洗澡前脱了衣服。
words.en: To remove one's clothes.

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.tr: n. 交会处；十字路口； v. 穿过；“cross”的现在分词；
words.ex: Be careful at the crossing near the school.
words.ex_cn: 在学校附近的交会处要小心。
words.en: A crossing is a place where something such as a road, river, or railway can be crossed safely.

words.tr: adv. 非常地；极其地；极端地；
words.ex: The weather is extremely cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气非常冷。
words.en: To an extreme degree; very.

words.tr: adj. 秃头的；不加修饰的；赤裸裸的
words.ex: The old man is bald.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是秃头的。
words.en: Someone who is bald has little or no hair on the top of their head.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.ex: He wrote, 'I love apples, bananas, and oranges.'
words.ex_cn: 他写道：'我喜欢苹果、香蕉和橙子。'
words.en: A comma is a punctuation mark (,) used to indicate a pause or to separate items in a list.

words.ex: The app has many daily users.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有很多日常用户。
words.en: A person who uses a product, service, or system, especially in a digital or technological context.

words.ex: The government took quick action to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 政府迅速采取行动解决问题。
words.en: The fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.ex: He is mostly late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他主要迟到上课。
words.en: You use mostly to indicate that a statement is generally true, for example true about most of a group of things or people, true most of the time, or true in most situations.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: His silence suggested he was unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他并不开心。
words.en: If you suggest something, you put forward a plan or idea for someone to think about.

words.ex: I pick the red shirt for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我为派对选择红色衬衫。
words.en: To choose something from a group of things or people, or to remove something from a place using your fingers or a tool.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.ex: He lives in the southern part of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的南部。
words.en: Located in or characteristic of a region in the south.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.ex: We stayed indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们待在室内。
words.en: If you are indoors, you are inside a building.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.tr:
n. 咬；咬伤；上钩；
v. 咬；叮；上钩；
words.ex: The dog gave him a sudden bite.
words.ex_cn: 狗突然咬了他一口。
words.en: If an animal or person bites you, they use their teeth to cut into your flesh.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: The soldier was spying on the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 这名士兵在夜间秘密侦察敌军营地。
words.en: A spy is a person who secretly collects and reports information about the activities, movements, and plans of an enemy or competitor.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.ex: He rolled up his sleeve to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他卷起袖子洗手。
words.en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.

words.ex: She put the ice cream in the freezer.
words.ex_cn: 她把冰淇淋放进冷冻柜里。
words.en: A freezer is a device that is used to store food at very low temperatures in order to preserve it.

words.tr: v. 买得起；担负得起；有时间做；
words.ex: I can't afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 我买不起一辆新车。
words.en: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

words.ex: The traveler walked through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅行者穿过森林。
words.en: A traveler is a person who is traveling or who often travels.

words.ex: He has a small mustache.
words.ex_cn: 他有一小撮胡子。
words.en: A mustache is a strip of hair left to grow above the upper lip.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.ex: The diver swam deep under the sea.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员在海底深处游泳。
words.en: A diver is someone who swims under water, especially someone who works under water looking for things or repairing ships.

words.tr:
n. 限制；
v. 限制；
words.ex: The teacher set a limit on homework time.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业时间设定了限制。
words.en: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

words.ex: The honey is sticky.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是黏的。
words.en: Something that is sticky is covered with a substance that things stick to.

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 滑冰；溜冰（指在冰面上穿着冰鞋滑行的运动或活动）
words.ex: He loves ice skating in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天滑冰。
words.en: the activity or sport of moving on ice using ice skates

words.tr: adv. 轻柔地；温和地；柔和地；
words.ex: She spoke softly to the baby.
words.ex_cn: 她轻柔地对婴儿说话。
words.en: In a gentle, quiet, or delicate manner.

words.tr: v. 位于；使坐落于；查找…的地点；确定…的位置；“locate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 坐落在；位于；
words.ex: The school is located near the park.
words.ex_cn: 学校位于公园附近。
words.en: If something is located in a particular place, it is in that place.

words.tr: adj. 有苦味的；激烈而不快的；痛苦的；刺痛的；
words.ex: The medicine tastes bitter.
words.ex_cn: 这种药尝起来很苦。
words.en: Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet. Feeling or showing anger, hurt, or resentment because of bad experiences or a sense of unjust treatment.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.ex: People in society should be kind to each other.
words.ex_cn: 社会中的人们应该彼此友善。
words.en: A society is the people who live in a country or region, their organizations, and their way of life.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.tr: n. 服务员；侍者；发球员；上菜用具
words.ex: The server brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A server is a computer or a device on a network that manages network resources. Servers are often dedicated, meaning that they perform no other tasks besides their server tasks.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: The cyclist rides his bike every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位骑自行车的人每天早上骑车。
words.en: A cyclist is someone who rides a bicycle.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The firefighter saved a dog from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 消防员从着火的房子里救出了一只狗。
words.en: A firefighter is a person whose job is to extinguish fires and rescue people from dangerous situations.

words.tr: adj. 不感兴趣的；漠不关心的；冷漠的；无关系的
words.ex: He was uninterested in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影不感兴趣。
words.en: If you are uninterested in something, you have no desire to learn more about it or to become involved with it.

words.ex: He learned a new technique to paint better.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一种新的绘画技术。
words.en: A technique is a particular method of doing an activity, usually a method that involves practical skills.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；“burn”的现在分词； adj. 燃烧的；强烈的；
words.ex: The wood is burning in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 木头正在壁炉里燃烧。
words.en: A burning issue or problem is very important and needs to be dealt with immediately.

words.ex: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙存在于数百万年前。
words.en: If something exists, it is present in the world as a real thing.

words.ex: The airline lost my luggage.
words.ex_cn: 这家航空公司弄丢了我的行李。
words.en: An airline is a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places.

words.tr: n. 美；美的事物；美丽；美人；
words.ex: The beauty of the sunset amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 日落的美让所有人都惊叹。
words.en: Beauty is the quality of being pleasing, especially to look at, or someone or something that gives great pleasure, especially when you look at it.

words.ex: The robot cleans the floor every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人每天打扫地板。
words.en: A robot is a machine that is programmed to move and perform certain tasks automatically.

words.ex: The captain sailed the ship across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船长驾驶船穿越了海洋。
words.en: A captain is the person in charge of a ship or an aircraft, or a leader of a team or group.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.ex: He joined the air force last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年加入了空军。
words.en: The branch of a nation's armed services that conducts military operations in the air.

words.tr:
n. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
v. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
words.ex: He went for a dive in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他去海里潜水。
words.en: If you dive into water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head. Dive is also a noun.

words.tr:
v. 打；敲打；击败；
n. 一击；跳动；
words.ex: He beat the drum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他用力敲打鼓。
words.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, election, or battle; to hit someone or something many times with your hand, a stick, etc.

words.ex: The filmmaker made a movie about dogs.
words.ex_cn: 这位电影制作人拍了一部关于狗的电影。
words.en: A filmmaker is a person who directs or produces movies for the cinema or television.

words.tr: v. 进行；继续；继续进行；“proceed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting is proceeding as planned.
words.ex_cn: 会议按计划进行。
words.en: A proceeding is an event or a series of actions, especially one that is formal or official.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: My friend lives next door.
words.ex_cn: 我的朋友住在隔壁。
words.en: Adjacent to the current location, typically referring to the house or building immediately beside.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: Fortunately, the bus came just in time.
words.ex_cn: 幸运的是，公交车正好准时到了。
words.en: Used to say that something good has happened, especially when it could have been bad.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.ex: She danced beautifully at the party.
words.ex_cn: 她在派对上漂亮地跳舞。
words.en: In a way that is pleasing to the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.ex: He used common sense to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用常识解决了这个问题。
words.en: Common sense is the natural ability to make good judgments and to behave in a practical and sensible way.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: He used a modal verb to show possibility.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一个情态动词来表示可能性。
words.en: A modal is a type of auxiliary verb that is used to indicate modality – that is, likelihood, ability, permission, and obligation.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was magnificent.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落壮丽极了。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.ex: It rained heavily last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚雨下得很大。
words.en: To a great degree; in large amounts.

words.ex: He is backpacking across Europe this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天正在欧洲背包旅行。
words.en: Backpacking is the activity of traveling while carrying your belongings in a backpack, especially when you are walking long distances.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.ex: He bought a secondhand bike for $50.
words.ex_cn: 他花50美元买了一辆二手自行车。
words.en: Something that is secondhand is not new and has been owned by someone else before.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.ex: He is selfish and never shares his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不分享他的玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they only care about their own interests and do not consider the needs or feelings of other people.

words.tr:
adj. 狭窄的；窄小的；
v. 使窄小；
words.ex: The road is narrow and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路很窄，开车很难。
words.en: If something narrows, or if you narrow it, it becomes less wide.

words.ex: He got a new haircut yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天理了一个新发型。
words.en: The act or process of cutting the hair.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.ex: He plays the flute every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吹长笛。
words.en: A flute is a musical instrument of the woodwind family. You play it by blowing over a hole at one end while holding it sideways.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: They talked face to face instead of on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他们面对面交谈，而不是打电话。
words.en: If you meet or talk to someone face to face, you meet or talk to them directly, rather than by telephone, email, or online.

words.tr: v. 放置；安放；下蛋；“lie”的过去式； adj. 外行的；非专业的；
words.ex: He lay the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: To put something down gently or carefully.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.tr: phrase. 不定冠词（英语中的 'a' 或 'an'）
words.ex: I saw a cat on the street.
words.ex_cn: 我在街上看到一只猫。
words.en: An indefinite article is a determiner (a, an) that introduces a noun phrase and implies that the thing referred to is nonspecific.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.tr: adj. 明智的；有判断力的；恰当的；合理的；
words.ex: It is sensible to wear a coat in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的天气里穿外套是明智的。
words.en: A sensible person is able to make good judgments and decisions based on reason rather than emotion.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.tr:
adj. 每月的；每月一次的；
n. 月刊；
adv. 每月一次；每个月；
words.ex: He pays his rent monthly.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付房租。
words.en: Monthly means happening or done once a month or every month.

words.tr: phrase. 视频片段；录像剪辑
words.ex: He watched a funny video clip on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他在他的手机上观看了一段有趣的短视频。
words.en: A video clip is a short video recording, especially one made from a longer video.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.ex: He worked here previously.
words.ex_cn: 他以前在这里工作。
words.en: At an earlier time or before.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.ex: The reporter asked the president a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 记者问了总统一个困难的问题。
words.en: A reporter is a person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper, magazine, radio, or television.

words.ex: The children are of different ages.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子的年龄不同。
words.en: Ages refers to a very long time or the period of history that is being referred to.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: The frog jumps over the pond.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跳过池塘。
words.en: A frog is a small creature with smooth skin, big eyes, and long back legs, which it uses for jumping. Frogs live in or near water.

words.tr:
v. 鼓掌；拍手
n. 鼓掌；拍手
words.ex: The crowd will clap after the song.
words.ex_cn: 歌曲结束后，观众会鼓掌。
words.en: To clap means to strike the palms of your hands together to show appreciation or to make a noise.

words.ex: The faucet is dripping.
words.ex_cn: 水龙头在滴水。
words.en: A faucet is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, especially one that you turn to start or stop the flow of water.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: He fries fish in a pan every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日用平底锅油炸鱼。
words.en: To cook something in hot fat or oil, or to be cooked in this way.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is painful.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口很疼。
words.en: If something is painful, it causes you a lot of physical or emotional pain.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: He is a writer who loves to write stories.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位喜欢写故事的作家。
words.en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job or regular occupation.

words.ex: He apologizes for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而道歉。
words.en: To express regret for something that one has done wrong.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: Can you pronounce this word correctly?
words.ex_cn: 你能正确发音这个词吗？
words.en: To pronounce means to make the sound of a word or letter with your voice. It can also mean to declare or announce something officially or formally.

words.ex: You ought to finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你应当在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: You use 'ought' to indicate that it is morally right or advisable for someone to do something, or to indicate that it is probable that something is true or will happen.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.tr:
n. 乘船游览；航游；
v. 乘船游览；航游；
words.ex: We went on a cruise around the Mediterranean Sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘船游览了地中海。
words.en: To sail about in an area without a precise destination, especially for pleasure.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.tr: phrase. 定冠词（如英语中的 the，用于特指某人或某物）
words.ex: The cat is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子上。
words.en: In English, the definite article is the word 'the', which is used to refer to a particular member of a group or class.

words.ex: His nickname is 'Speedy' because he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的绰号是‘飞毛腿’，因为他跑得快。
words.en: A nickname is an informal name for someone or something, especially a name that you are called by your friends or family, usually based on your real name or your character.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.tr: adj. 高兴的；愉快的；快乐的； v. “delight”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She was delighted to see her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她见到朋友很高兴。
words.en: If you are delighted, you are extremely pleased and happy about something.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.ex: The sun shines brightly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早晨明亮地发光。
words.en: To emit or reflect light brightly; to be very good at something.

words.ex: He rubbed his chin when he thought.
words.ex_cn: 他思考时摸了摸下巴。
words.en: The part of the face below the mouth and above the neck.

words.tr: n. （车辆等的）停放；停车场所；停车位； v. “park”的现在分词；
words.ex: There is no parking near the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校附近没有停车的地方。
words.en: Parking refers to the act of stopping a vehicle and leaving it temporarily in a particular place.

words.ex: This store sells inexpensive clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这家店卖不贵的衣服。
words.en: Something that is inexpensive does not cost a lot of money.

words.ex: Wearing blue jeans is fashionable now.
words.ex_cn: 现在穿牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: Something that is fashionable is popular or approved of at a particular time.

words.ex: He loves playing sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: Sports are physical activities or games, often competitive and organized, that involve skill and physical exertion.

words.ex: He fixed the electrical wire with tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶带修好了电线。
words.en: Relating to electricity or things that use electricity.

words.ex: She has curly hair.
words.ex_cn: 她有一头卷发。
words.en: Having curls or a curved shape.

words.ex: She knit a warm scarf for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的弟弟织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

words.ex: He eats a pea from his plate.
words.ex_cn: 他从盘子里吃了一颗豌豆。
words.en: A pea is a small, round, green seed which is eaten as a vegetable and which is formed in a pod on a climbing plant.

words.ex: The kitten is sleeping on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 小猫正在沙发上睡觉。
words.en: A kitten is a very young cat.

words.ex: His room is messy with clothes everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很杂乱，衣服到处都是。
words.en: If you describe something as messy, you mean that it is untidy or dirty.

words.ex: He walked backwards to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走到门边。
words.en: If you move or look backwards, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: I took a cab to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A cab is a taxi, a vehicle that carries passengers for a fare, usually calculated by a meter.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.ex: The dinosaur lived in a long period ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙生活在很久以前的一个时期。
words.en: A period is a length of time in which something happens, or a stretch of time with a particular quality or characteristic.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自西南方向。
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.tr: n. 游泳运动员；游泳者；
words.ex: He is a fast swimmer who won the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名速度快的游泳运动员，赢得了金牌。
words.en: A swimmer is a person who swims, especially as a sport or regularly for exercise.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.ex: This phone is out of date.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了。
words.en: No longer fashionable or current; obsolete.

words.ex: The neighbor gave an unfriendly look.
words.ex_cn: 邻居给了一个不友好的眼神。
words.en: If you describe someone as unfriendly, you mean that they behave in a hostile or unsympathetic way.

words.ex: Eating too much sugar is unhealthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃太多糖是不健康的。
words.en: If you describe something as unhealthy, you mean that it is likely to cause illness or poor health.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.ex: I disagree with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意你的观点。
words.en: If you disagree with someone or disagree with what they say, you do not accept that what they say is true or you do not accept that it is the correct thing to do.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.ex: Immigration to this country has increased recently.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的移民数量最近增加了。
words.en: Immigration is the act of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own.

words.ex: Spring is a beautiful season.
words.ex_cn: 春天是一个美丽的季节。
words.en: A season is one of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. It can also refer to a period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc., or a period of the year when a particular sport is played.

words.tr: adj. 恐惧的；受惊吓的； v. “terrify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was terrified of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: If you are terrified, you are extremely frightened.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The baker makes bread every morning.
words.ex_cn: 面包师每天早上都做面包。
words.en: A baker is a person whose job is to bake bread, cakes, or pastries.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: You ought to drink more water.
words.ex_cn: 你应该多喝水。
words.en: Used to indicate duty or correctness, typically when criticizing someone's actions.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他敲了敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.ex: He walks one mile to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天步行一英里去学校。
words.en: A unit of linear measure equal to 1,760 yards (approximately 1.609 kilometers).

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口正在流血。
words.en: When you bleed, blood flows from your body, usually because you are injured.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.ex: The lady is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 这位女士正在等公交车。
words.en: A lady is a woman who is polite, well-mannered, and refined.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He made a correction to his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了他的答案。
words.en: A correction is a change that makes something right, accurate, or better.

words.ex: He ate a slice of apple pie for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块苹果派作为甜点。
words.en: A pie is a baked dish which is usually made of a pastry dough casing that contains a filling of various sweet or savoury ingredients.

words.tr:
n. 头脑；意向；心；智力；
v. 介意；注意；
words.ex: He lost his mind after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了理智。
words.en: Your mind is your ability to think and reason. If you mind something, you are bothered by it or you object to it.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: He eats a cucumber for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一根黄瓜。
words.en: A cucumber is a long, green vegetable with a high water content, used in salads and for pickling.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: He is a famous poet who writes simple poems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位写简单诗歌的著名诗人。
words.en: A poet is a person who writes poems.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.tr: n. 新来者；陌生人； adj. “strange”的比较级；
words.ex: He is a stranger in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个镇上的新来者。
words.en: A stranger is someone you have never met before.

words.tr: adj. 令人吃惊的；出人意料的； v. “surprise”的现在分词；
words.ex: It was surprising that he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，这令人吃惊。
words.en: Causing surprise; unexpected.

words.ex: We woke up early to see the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 我们早起看日出。
words.en: The time in the morning when the sun appears or full daylight arrives.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: The keys are within the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: If something is within a place, area, or object, it is inside it or surrounded by it.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.tr: adv. 好奇地；奇异地；奇怪地
words.ex: He looked curiously at the strange box.
words.ex_cn: 他好奇地看着那个奇怪的盒子。
words.en: In a way that shows eagerness to know or learn something.

words.tr: adj. 有限的； v. 限制；“limit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: We have limited time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们完成这个项目的时间是有限的。
words.en: If something is limited, there is only a certain amount of it.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.ex: Many people face unemployment during the economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 在经济危机期间，许多人面临失业。
words.en: Unemployment refers to the state of being without a job, especially when one is actively seeking employment.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: He is a handsome boy.
words.ex_cn: 他是个英俊的男孩。
words.en: A handsome man is good-looking, usually in a way that is attractive to women. Something that is handsome is large in quantity or impressive in quality.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.ex: He bought a recent book about history.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本最近出版的历史书。
words.en: Having happened, begun, or been done not long ago or not long before; belonging to a past period comparatively close to the present.

words.tr: phrase. 五斗柜；装抽屉的柜子，用于存放衣物等物品
words.ex: He keeps his clothes in a chest of drawers.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放在抽屉柜里。
words.en: A piece of furniture consisting of a set of drawers in a frame, typically used for storing clothes.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；施行手术；
words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.tr:
adj. 该死的；可恶的；糟透的
v. 咒骂（某人下地狱）
words.ex: It's a damn good idea.
words.ex_cn: 这是个该死的好主意。
words.en: If you say that someone is damned if they do something, you mean that they will be in a very difficult situation if they do it.

words.ex: This is a basic math skill.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个基本的数学技能。
words.en: You use basic to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or necessary, and on which others depend.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: The teacher will announce the results tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将宣布结果。
words.en: To announce something means to make it known publicly or officially.

words.ex: The lightning struck the tree last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚闪电击中了那棵树。
words.en: A flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another or between a cloud and the earth.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.ex: He used the cash machine to get money.
words.ex_cn: 他使用取款机取钱。
words.en: A cash machine is a machine, usually in a wall outside a bank, from which you can take money out of your bank account using a special card.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.ex: He walked directly to the school.
words.ex_cn: 他直接走向学校。
words.en: If you do something directly, you do it without any delay or without involving anyone else.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: He is interested in political news.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治新闻感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to the government or public affairs of a country.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
words.ex_cn: 他爬梯子去修屋顶。
words.en: A ladder is a piece of equipment consisting of a series of steps or rungs fixed between two upright lengths of wood, metal, or rope, used for climbing up or down something.

words.ex: There is a hole in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一个洞。
words.en: A hole is an opening or hollow space in something solid, or a place in the ground that is deeper than the surface around it.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.tr: adj. 受过教育的；有教养的； v. 教育；“educate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an educated man who reads books every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天都读书的受过教育的人。
words.en: Having been educated; having received education.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: The telephone was a great invention.
words.ex_cn: 电话是一项伟大的发明。
words.en: An invention is a unique or novel device, method, composition or process. It may be an improvement upon a machine or product, or a new process for creating an object or a result. An invention that achieves a completely unique function or result may be a radical breakthrough. Such works are novel and not obvious to others skilled in the same field.

words.ex: He proved the theorem with simple math.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的数学证明了这个定理。
words.en: To prove something means to show that it is true or correct by providing evidence or argument.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.tr: phrase. 极限运动（指高风险、高强度、高刺激性的体育活动，如蹦极、滑板、自由式滑雪等）
words.ex: He loves doing extreme sports like skydiving and rock climbing.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢玩蹦极和攀岩这样的极限运动。
words.en: Extreme sports are activities perceived as involving a high degree of risk. These activities often involve speed, height, a high level of physical exertion, and highly specialized gear.

words.ex: He was late because of a traffic jam.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: A traffic jam is a long line of vehicles that cannot move forward because there is too much traffic, or because the road is blocked by something.

words.ex: He solved the problem amazingly fast.
words.ex_cn: 他令人惊讶地快速解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that causes great surprise or wonder.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.tr: adj. 讨厌的； v. “annoy”的现在分词；
words.ex: The loud noise is annoying.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音很讨厌。
words.en: Something that is annoying makes you feel fairly angry and impatient.

words.ex: The old ship was a monster on the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船在海上是个庞然大物。
words.en: A monster is an imaginary creature that is very large, ugly, and frightening.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.ex: The children played on the shore of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖岸玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water.

words.ex: The company has a simple logo on its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的产品上有一个简单的标志。
words.en: A logo is a design or symbol used by a company to identify its products, services, or itself.

words.ex: She wears stylish clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着时髦的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is stylish is fashionable and attractive.

words.ex: He gave me a suggestion to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提了一个多吃蔬菜的建议。
words.en: A suggestion is an idea or plan that someone puts forward for consideration.

words.ex: He stayed home because of illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: An illness is a particular disease, especially one that is not very serious.

words.ex: He called urgently for help.
words.ex_cn: 他紧急地呼救。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with immediately.

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我感觉明天会下雨。
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.ex: He forgot his password and could not log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码，无法登录。
words.en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place or to use a computer system.

words.ex: Please go to the checkout to pay for your groceries.
words.ex_cn: 请去付款处支付你的杂货。
words.en: The act of paying for goods or services in a store, or the place where this is done.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He bravely faced the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他勇敢地面对了风暴。
words.en: In a manner that shows courage or determination.

words.ex: He gave a rose to his lover on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节给情人送了一朵玫瑰。
words.en: A lover is someone who is in a romantic or sexual relationship with another person, or someone who enjoys a particular thing or activity very much.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The child drew a picture of an angel with wings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅有翅膀的天使的画。
words.en: An angel is a spiritual being believed to act as a messenger or servant of God, conventionally represented in human form with wings and a long robe.

words.tr: n. 加热；供暖设备；采暖； v. 加热；“heat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heating of the room takes five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 房间的加热需要五分钟。
words.en: The process of making something warm or hot, or the system that does this.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: Farmers grow corn as a crop.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植玉米作为农作物。
words.en: A crop is a plant such as wheat, potatoes, or cotton that is grown in large quantities by farmers.

words.ex: The view from the mountain is marvelous.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色极好。
words.en: If you describe something as marvelous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely good.

words.ex: She put flowers in a vase on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把花放在桌子上的花瓶里。
words.en: A vase is a container, often used for holding cut flowers. It can be made from a variety of materials, including glass, ceramics, and metals.

words.ex: The dolphin jumped high out of the water.
words.ex_cn: 海豚从水中高高跳起。
words.en: A dolphin is a marine mammal that is known for its intelligence and friendly nature towards humans.

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.ex: The loud music annoys me.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我烦恼。
words.en: If someone or something annoys you, it makes you fairly angry and impatient.

words.tr:
n. 旗；旗帜；信号旗；
v. 用旗标记；
words.ex: The flag waves in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.en: A flag is a piece of cloth with a special design or colors that is used as a symbol, or to give a signal.

words.tr: abbr. （广播电台）流行音乐播音员；流行音乐节目主持人 ；“disc jockey”的缩写
words.ex: He is a dj at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他是派对上的DJ。
words.en: An abbreviation for 'disc jockey,' a person who selects and plays recorded music for an audience, especially on radio or at events.

words.tr: v. 使用；利用；“use”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 习惯的；使用过的；二手的；
words.ex: He used a pen to write the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支笔写了这封信。
words.en: Previously owned by someone else; second-hand.

words.ex: He went to the nightclub with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们去了夜总会。
words.en: A nightclub is a place where people go late in the evening to drink and dance.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.ex: He takes public transportation to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transportation refers to the system of buses, trains, subways, etc., that is available for use by the public and is usually operated by a government or private company.

words.tr: n. 警示； v. 警告；“warn”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign gave a warning about the slippery road.
words.ex_cn: 标志提醒了道路湿滑的警示。
words.en: A warning is something which is said or written to tell people of a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant thing that might happen.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.ex: The reader enjoyed the novel very much.
words.ex_cn: 这位读者非常喜欢这本小说。
words.en: A person who reads or who is fond of reading.

words.ex: I am terribly sorry for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我为这个错误非常抱歉。
words.en: Used to emphasize the extreme degree of something.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr:
n. 塞子；
v. 插上；
words.ex: The sink is clogged because the plug is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 水槽堵塞了，因为塞子卡住了。
