words.en: If a company, industry, or service that is owned by the state is privatized, the government sells it and makes it a private company.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.ex: The manager will authorize the payment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 经理明天将批准这笔付款。
words.en: To give official permission for something to happen, or to give someone official permission to do something.

words.ex: The engineer checked the specification for the machine.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了机器的规格。
words.en: A specification is a detailed description of the design and materials used to make something.

words.ex: He bought a brass lamp at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个黄铜制品台灯。
words.en: Brass is a yellow-coloured metal made from copper and zinc. It is used especially for making ornaments and musical instruments.

words.ex: The company will deploy new software next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周部署新软件。
words.en: To deploy troops or military resources means to organize or position them so that they are ready to be used.

words.ex: The child rides a pony in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在公园里骑小马。
words.en: A pony is a small horse.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: The sun shone with great glory at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，太阳闪耀着辉煌的光辉。
words.en: High renown or honor won by notable achievements; magnificence or great beauty.

words.ex: The proceeds from the sale went to charity.
words.ex_cn: 销售所得收益捐给了慈善机构。
words.en: Proceeds are the money that is received from a particular event or activity, especially when it is used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The scholar published a book about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位学者出版了一本关于古代历史的书。
words.en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

words.ex: The noise from the construction caused a disturbance.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工地的噪音造成了干扰。
words.en: A disturbance is an event or situation in which people behave in a noisy or violent way, or something that interrupts what you are doing.

words.tr: adj. 综合的；整合的；融合的； v. 整合；结合；“integrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school offers an integrated science course.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校提供一门综合科学课程。
words.en: An integrated system or approach combines different groups or ideas in a way that works well.

words.ex: His mentality changed after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他的心理状态发生了变化。
words.en: Your mentality is your attitudes and your way of thinking.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.tr:
v. 进行无记名投票 
n. 无记名投票
words.ex: He cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他在选举中投了票。
words.en: A ballot is a process of voting, in writing and typically in secret. It is also the piece of paper on which you mark your vote.

words.tr: n. 切割；剪辑； v. 削减；切；割；“cut”的现在分词； adj. 锐利的；
words.ex: The cutting of the tree took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 砍树的切割只用了五分钟。
words.en: The act or process of cutting something; a piece cut off from something, especially a plant.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.ex: She likes swimming, which is a gerund.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢游泳，这是一个动名词。
words.en: A gerund is a noun formed from a verb which refers to an action, process, or state. In English, gerunds end in -ing (e.g., 'swimming' in 'Swimming is good exercise.').

words.ex: The cop stopped the car for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 警察因超速拦下了那辆车。
words.en: A cop is a police officer. To cop means to catch or arrest someone.

words.ex: The premise of his argument is that everyone is equal.
words.ex_cn: 他论点的前提是人人平等。
words.en: A premise is a statement or idea that forms the basis for a reasonable line of argument.

words.ex: He is presently working at a bank.
words.ex_cn: 他现在在一家银行工作。
words.en: At the present time; now. Or in a short time; soon.

words.ex: She sensibly saved money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 她明智地为将来存钱。
words.en: In a way that shows good judgment; reasonably.

words.ex: Some people follow that cult blindly.
words.ex_cn: 有些人盲目追随那个狂热崇拜。
words.en: A cult is a group of people who have extreme admiration for a particular person, idea, or thing, often following unusual or extreme practices or beliefs.

words.ex: Her family is middle-class and lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 她的家庭是中产阶级，住在一所小房子里。
words.en: The middle class is the social group that is between the upper class and the working class, typically including professionals, business people, and their families.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.ex: The company built a large scale factory to make more products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司建造了一个大规模的工厂来生产更多产品。
words.en: Involving or affecting a large number of people or things; extensive.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The police used surveillance to watch the building.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用监视来观察那栋大楼。
words.en: The careful watching of a person or place, especially by the police or army, because of a crime that has happened or is expected.

words.ex: The boy hurt his spine when he fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他从树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。
words.en: The spine is the row of bones down the center of your back that supports your body and protects your spinal cord.

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.tr: adj. 烦恼的； v. “distress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She looked distressed after hearing the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 听到坏消息后，她显得很烦恼。
words.en: If someone is distressed, they are extremely upset.

words.tr: v. 使不知所措；使无法解决；击败；压垮；淹没
words.ex: The homework overwhelms her every night.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上的作业让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: To overwhelm means to bury or drown beneath a huge mass of something, or to defeat someone completely.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.tr: adj. 有特权的； v. “privilege”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a privileged student who gets free books.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有特权的学生，能免费获得书籍。
words.en: Having special rights, advantages, or immunities.

words.ex: He is the nominee for best actor.
words.ex_cn: 他是最佳男演员的提名人。
words.en: A nominee is someone who is proposed for an official position or for an honour or award.

words.ex: The militia protected the village during the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 民兵在冲突期间保护了村庄。
words.en: A militia is a group of people who are not professional soldiers but who have military training and can act as an army.

words.ex: He enquired about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了火车时刻表。
words.en: If you enquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr: n. 人群；集合在一起的群众；（教堂中的）会众
words.ex: A large congregation gathered in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 一大群人聚集在广场上参加节日。
words.en: A congregation is a group of people who are gathered together in a church or synagogue for a religious service.

words.ex: He answered the question unwillingly.
words.ex_cn: 他不情愿地回答了问题。
words.en: In a way that shows you do not want to do something.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.ex: There is a correlation between exercise and good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间存在相关性。
words.en: A correlation between things is a connection or link between them.

words.ex: He ate a moderate amount of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了适量的食物。
words.en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent, or if you moderate a discussion, you help the people in it to reach an agreement.

words.ex: His deficiency in math made him struggle in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的缺乏让他在课堂上很吃力。
words.en: A deficiency is a lack or shortage of something that is needed.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.ex: The soldiers walked across the battlefield.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们走过战场。
words.en: A battlefield is a place where a battle is fought.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: The equation is easy to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程式很容易解。
words.en: An equation is a mathematical statement that asserts the equality of two expressions.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.ex: He preaches kindness every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都宣扬仁爱。
words.en: If you preach, you give a talk on a religious or moral subject during a religious service.

words.tr: adj. 司法的；法庭的；审判的；
words.ex: The judicial system protects people's rights.
words.ex_cn: 司法系统保护人民的权利。
words.en: Judicial means relating to the legal system and to judgments made in a court of law.

words.ex: The new policy substantially improved the results.
words.ex_cn: 新政策实质上改善了结果。
words.en: To a great extent or degree; considerably.

words.ex: This test is a benchmark for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试是所有学生的标准。
words.en: A benchmark is something whose quality or quantity is known and which can therefore be used as a standard with which other things can be compared.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.tr:
v. 触发；引起；发动；
n. 诱因；触发；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: A trigger is a device that activates a mechanism when it is pulled or pressed. It can also refer to something that causes a particular reaction or development.

words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.tr: v. 重新思考；重新考虑；
words.ex: We need to rethink our plan.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要重新思考我们的计划。
words.en: To consider again, especially with a view to changing or altering.

words.ex: The temple is a sacred place for believers.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙对信徒来说是神圣的地方。
words.en: Something that is sacred is considered to be holy or connected with God or a god.

words.ex: The weather will deteriorate tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天天气会恶化。
words.en: If something deteriorates, it becomes worse in some way.

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.tr: v. 激怒；使急躁；使疼痛
words.ex: Loud noises irritate my baby.
words.ex_cn: 噪音会激怒我的宝宝。
words.en: If something irritates you, it keeps annoying you.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He wrote a memo to remind the team.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一封备忘录提醒团队。
words.en: A memo is a short official note that is sent by one person to another within the same company or organization.

words.ex: France is a republic with a president.
words.ex_cn: 法国是一个有总统的共和国。
words.en: A republic is a country where power is held by the people or their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

words.ex: The spokesman spoke clearly at the press conference.
words.ex_cn: 发言人在新闻发布会上清晰地发言。
words.en: A spokesman is a man who speaks on behalf of a group or an organization.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.ex: He is supposedly coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 据推测他明天来。
words.en: If you say that something is supposedly the case, you mean that people say it is the case but you do not think it is necessarily true.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死病菌。
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: The scientist created a cocktail of chemicals for the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 科学家为实验配制了一种化学混合物。
words.en: A cocktail is a mixed drink typically made with a combination of alcoholic beverages and other ingredients such as fruit juices, syrups, or cream.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: Too many rules can complicate the game.
words.ex_cn: 太多的规则会使游戏变得复杂。
words.en: To make something more difficult to understand or deal with by adding more parts or details.

words.tr: n. 魔鬼；恶魔；精力充沛的人；高手
words.ex: The child fears the demon in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子害怕黑暗中的恶魔。
words.en: A demon is an evil spirit.

words.tr: n. 调整器；调节器；监管者
words.ex: The regulator controls the water pressure in the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 这个调整器控制管道中的水压。
words.en: A regulator is a person or organization appointed by a government to regulate an area of activity such as banking or industry.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；
words.ex: He is a notorious thief who stole from many stores.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个声名狼藉的小偷，偷过许多商店。
words.en: Someone or something that is notorious is well known for something bad.

words.tr: adj. 过时的；废弃的；淘汰的；
words.ex: This phone is obsolete because it doesn't work with new apps.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机已经过时了，因为它不能使用新应用。
words.en: Something that is obsolete is no longer needed because something better has been invented.

words.ex: There has been slow progression in his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学技能有了缓慢的进展。
words.en: The process of developing or moving gradually towards a more advanced state.

words.ex: He computes the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快算出总成本。
words.en: If you compute a total, amount, or result, you calculate it.

words.ex: He radically changed his mind about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底改变了对这个计划的想法。
words.en: In a way that is very different from the usual or traditional way.

words.ex: He made a pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了帮助穷人的保证。
words.en: A pledge is a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially. It can also refer to something given as security for the fulfillment of a contract or the payment of a debt.

words.ex: Ancient warfare used swords and shields.
words.ex_cn: 古代战争使用剑和盾。
words.en: Warfare is the activity of fighting a war.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: He reluctantly agreed to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他不情愿地同意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If you do something reluctantly, you do it unwillingly.

words.ex: He wrote a memoir about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于自己童年的回忆录。
words.en: A memoir is a book or article that you write about someone who you have known, describing what you remember of them and of particular events in which you both took part.

words.ex: The government started privatization of public buses.
words.ex_cn: 政府开始将公共汽车私有化。
words.en: The transfer of ownership, property or business from the government to the private sector is termed privatization.

words.tr: adj. 单调乏味的；毫无变化的；
words.ex: The work is monotonous and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作单调乏味。
words.en: Something that is monotonous is very boring because it has a regular, repeated pattern which never changes.

words.tr: v. 接受；“accept”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 公认的；
words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: Generally agreed to be correct or satisfactory.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.ex: The company used a short slogan to attract customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司用了一个简短的口号来吸引顾客。
words.en: A short and striking or memorable phrase used in advertising or politics.

words.ex: The company showed compliance with safety rules.
words.ex_cn: 该公司遵守了安全规定。
words.en: The act of complying with a wish, request, or demand; obedience.

words.tr: v. 发音；宣告；“pronounce”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 显著的；
words.ex: He pronounced the word correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地发音了这个单词。
words.en: Something that is pronounced is very noticeable or obvious.

words.ex: The rebellion against the king failed.
words.ex_cn: 反对国王的叛乱失败了。
words.en: A rebellion is an organized attempt to overthrow a government or authority by a group of people.

words.ex: The heroic firefighter saved the child from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 这位英勇的消防员从着火的房子里救出了孩子。
words.en: If you describe a person or their actions as heroic, you admire them because they show extreme bravery.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.tr: n. 收容所；避难所；精神病院；（政治）庇护
words.ex: The old building now serves as an asylum for the homeless.
words.ex_cn: 这栋旧建筑现在是无家可归者的收容所。
words.en: An asylum is a place where people who are in danger or who have no homes can go for safety and protection.

words.ex: The mountain is immense.
words.ex_cn: 这座山非常巨大。
words.en: Extremely large or great, especially in scale or degree.

words.ex: He explicitly said no to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他明确地拒绝了这个提议。
words.en: In a clear and detailed manner, leaving no room for confusion or doubt.

words.tr: n. 相互作用；相互影响；互动交流；
words.ex: The interaction between the two chemicals causes a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质之间的相互作用引起反应。
words.en: An interaction is a situation where two or more people or things communicate with or react to each other.

words.ex: I am somewhat tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 下班后我有点累。
words.en: You use somewhat to indicate that something is the case to a limited extent or degree.

words.tr: n. 被告； v. 指控；指责；“accuse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The accused spoke calmly in court.
words.ex_cn: 被告在法庭上平静地发言。
words.en: Someone who is accused of a crime has been officially charged with it.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.tr: adj. 买不起的；负担不起的；
words.ex: The house was unaffordable for them.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子他们买不起。
words.en: If something is unaffordable, it is too expensive for people to be able to buy it or pay for it.

words.ex: The line is horizontal on the graph.
words.ex_cn: 这条线在图上是水平的。
words.en: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.tr: n. 修辞学；花言巧语；华丽的文辞；
words.ex: He studied rhetoric to improve his speaking skills.
words.ex_cn: 他学习修辞学以提高自己的演讲能力。
words.en: Rhetoric is the art or study of using language effectively and persuasively.

words.tr: adj. 联邦的；联邦制的；联邦政府的；
words.ex: The federal government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 联邦政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A federal system of government is one in which there is a central government and separate governments for each of the states or regions.

words.ex: He uses this park exclusively for walking.
words.ex_cn: 他只在这个公园散步。
words.en: If you do something exclusively, you do it only in the way mentioned, and not in any other way.

words.tr: adj. 剧增的；高耸云霄的； v. “soar”的现在分词；
words.ex: The soaring prices made people angry.
words.ex_cn: 剧增的价格让人们感到愤怒。
words.en: If something such as a bird soars into the air, it goes quickly and smoothly upwards.

words.tr: v. 接着发生；因而产生
words.ex: The storm ended, and peace ensued.
words.ex_cn: 风暴结束后，和平随之而来。
words.en: If something ensues, it happens immediately after another event, usually as a result of it.

words.tr: adj. 引起兴趣的； v. 吸引；“appeal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book has an appealing story.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个引人入胜的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as appealing, you mean that you like them or they make you want to have or do something.

words.ex: The storm caused a brutal flood that destroyed many homes.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了残酷的洪水，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A brutal act or person is cruel and violent.

words.ex: He is unreasonably late for school.
words.ex_cn: 他上学迟到了不合理地久。
words.en: In a manner that is not guided by or based on good sense; excessively.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.ex: The hikers struggled across the rough terrain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿越了崎岖的地形。
words.en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

words.tr:
n. 步枪；来复枪（又称来福枪）
v. 快速搜寻
words.ex: He carries a rifle in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他带着一把步枪在森林里。
words.en: A rifle is a gun with a long barrel which you hold against your shoulder when firing.

words.ex: The school held a bake sale for fundraising.
words.ex_cn: 学校举办了一个烘焙义卖来筹款。
words.en: Fundraising is the activity of collecting money to support a charity or political campaign or organization.

words.ex: He stayed neutral in the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: If you say that someone is neutral, you mean that they do not support or help either side in a disagreement, competition, or war.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.ex: The medicine helps inhibit pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制疼痛。
words.en: If something inhibits an event or process, it prevents it or slows it down.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: The child's innocence showed in his honest smile.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的无罪体现在他诚实的微笑中。
words.en: the state or quality of being innocent, especially freedom from sin, moral wrong, or guilt through lack of knowledge of evil

words.ex: The company made a cutback on office supplies.
words.ex_cn: 公司减少了办公用品的开支。
words.en: A reduction in something, especially in the amount of money spent on a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.ex: He dressed inappropriately for the formal event.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着不适合正式场合的衣服。
words.en: In a way that is not suitable or proper in the circumstances.

words.ex: He moved from the island to the mainland for work.
words.ex_cn: 他从岛屿搬到大陆工作。
words.en: The mainland is the main part of a country or continent, as opposed to islands or peninsulas.

words.ex: He is in rehabilitation after his surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他术后正在康复。
words.en: Rehabilitation is the process of helping someone to have a normal, useful life again after they have been very ill or in prison, or the process of returning a building or area to its previous good condition.

words.ex: The richness of the land helped the village grow.
words.ex_cn: 土地的富裕帮助了村庄发展。
words.en: The quality of being rich in a particular thing, especially in a way that is pleasant or desirable.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: The red team played versus the blue team.
words.ex_cn: 红队与蓝队比赛。
words.en: Used to indicate the two sides in a competition or conflict.

words.ex: He is a man of great wit.
words.ex_cn: 他是个极具机智的人。
words.en: Wit is the ability to use words or ideas in a quick, clever, and amusing way.

words.ex: The rope is 100 footage long.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子长100英尺。
words.en: Footage refers to a sequence of film or video that has been shot, especially when it is used in a news broadcast or a documentary.

words.tr:
n. 雄鹿；公羊；雄兔；美元
v. （马等）猛然弓背跃起；抵制
words.ex: The buck ran through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 雄鹿在森林中奔跑。
words.en: A buck is a male deer, antelope, rabbit, or hare. It can also refer to a dollar in American slang. As a verb, it means to jump or to resist something.

words.ex: The old mill stands by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊坐落在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour. It can also refer to a factory where certain materials are processed or manufactured.

words.ex: The substitution of sugar with honey made the cake healthier.
words.ex_cn: 用蜂蜜代替糖使蛋糕更健康。
words.en: The act of replacing one person or thing with another.

words.tr: adj. 真正的；真实的；真迹的；可靠的；
words.ex: This is an authentic painting by Picasso.
words.ex_cn: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。
words.en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.ex: He is a well-educated man who works at a university.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位受过良好教育的男子，在大学工作。
words.en: Someone who is well-educated has received a good education and has a lot of knowledge.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.ex: He has three hobbies, namely reading, swimming, and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他有三个爱好，即阅读、游泳和绘画。
words.en: You use namely to introduce detailed information about the subject you are discussing, or a particular aspect of it.

words.ex: The non-profit helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个非营利组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A non-profit organization is one that is not run with the aim of making a profit.

words.ex: The door is partially open.
words.ex_cn: 门部分开着。
words.en: To a limited degree or in a limited manner; not completely.

words.tr: v. 制定（法律）；通过（法律）；扮演（角色）
words.ex: The government will enact a new law next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将颁布一项新法律。
words.en: To enact a law or rule means to make it official by passing it through a legislative body.

words.ex: Birds begin migration in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在秋天开始迁徙。
words.en: The movement of people, animals, or birds from one place to another, especially regularly according to the seasons.

words.tr:
n. 性格外向者；爱交际的人
adj. 外向的
words.ex: He is an extrovert who loves talking to people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个外向的人，喜欢和人交谈。
words.en: An extrovert is someone who is very outgoing, sociable, and enjoys being around other people.

words.ex: The shareholder voted on the company's new plan.
words.ex_cn: 股东对公司的新计划进行了投票。
words.en: A shareholder is a person who owns shares in a company and therefore gets part of the company's profits and the right to vote on how the company is managed.

words.tr:
v. 放电；放出；
n. 排放；
words.ex: The battery will discharge if left unused for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 如果长时间不使用，电池会放电。
words.en: If someone is discharged from a hospital, prison, or the armed forces, they are officially allowed to leave, or told that they must leave. If something is discharged from inside a place, it comes out.

words.ex: The engineer checked the alignment of the wheels.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了车轮的对齐。
words.en: The arrangement of something in a straight line or in correct relative positions.

words.tr: adj. 全世界的；四海一家的；
words.ex: This city has a cosmopolitan population.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有着来自世界各地的人口。
words.en: A cosmopolitan place or society is full of people from many different countries and cultures.

words.ex: The scenic lake attracted many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 风景优美的湖泊吸引了许多游客。
words.en: Relating to or resembling scenery; picturesque.

words.ex: It rained all day, hence the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use hence to indicate that the statement you are about to make is a consequence of what you have just said.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.tr: v. 朝向；前进；“head”的现在分词； n. 标题；
words.ex: The ship is heading north.
words.ex_cn: 船正朝北航行。
words.en: A heading is a word, phrase, or sentence at the beginning of a written passage that explains what it's about.

words.ex: Good decision-making helps teams succeed.
words.ex_cn: 良好的决策有助于团队成功。
words.en: The process of making choices, especially important ones, in an organization or group.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: The new house has a spacious living room.
words.ex_cn: 这所新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。
words.en: A spacious room, building, or place is large in size or area, so that you can move around freely in it.

words.ex: The company is improving its recruitment process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在改进它的招聘流程。
words.en: The process of finding and hiring new employees for a company or organization.

words.ex: He did it for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 他为了她的缘故做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result. You can also say that you do it for something's sake.

words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.ex: He added unnecessary details unnecessarily.
words.ex_cn: 他不必要地添加了不必要的细节。
words.en: In a manner that is not necessary or required.

words.ex: The university conferred an honorary degree on him.
words.ex_cn: 大学授予他一个荣誉学位。
words.en: To confer something such as a degree or an honor on someone means to give it to them in a formal way. To confer with someone means to discuss something with them in order to make a decision.

words.ex: The storm was destructive and broke many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴具有破坏性，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: He believed his destiny was to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己的命运是成为一名医生。
words.en: Destiny is the force which some people believe controls the things that happen to you in your life.

words.ex: The church teaches its doctrine to all members.
words.ex_cn: 教会向所有成员传授它的教义。
words.en: A doctrine is a set of beliefs or principles that are taught or accepted by a particular group, especially in religion or politics.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.tr: v. 强烈吸引住；使着迷；
words.ex: The magic show fascinated the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演深深吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.tr:
n. 首次露面；初次登场
v. 初次登场；首次推出
words.ex: He made his debut on stage last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚在舞台上首次登台。
words.en: The debut of a performer or sports player is their first public performance, appearance, or recording.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；冷漠的；
words.ex: The morning air was chilly.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的空气很寒冷。
words.en: Something that is chilly is unpleasantly cold.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.ex: The marine birds fly over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海鸟在海面上飞翔。
words.en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the ships and boats which sail on it.

words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.ex: I bought some milk, and incidentally, I saw your friend.
words.ex_cn: 我买了一些牛奶，顺便见到了你的朋友。
words.en: used to add something to what was said before, often something that you have just thought of

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.tr: n. 副标题；字幕；“subtitle”的复数；
words.ex: The movie has English subtitles.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有英文字幕。
words.en: Subtitles are words shown at the bottom of a film or television screen that translate or transcribe the dialogue or narrative.

words.ex: The loud noise stunned him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他震惊了。
words.en: To stun someone means to shock or surprise them very much.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr: v. 促进；使便利；使容易；
words.ex: The teacher facilitates learning by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来促进学习。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

words.tr: n. 热心者；热衷于…的人
words.ex: He is an enthusiast of basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球的爱好者。
words.en: An enthusiast is a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject and who spends a lot of time on it.

words.ex: The system has a vulnerability that hackers can exploit.
words.ex_cn: 这个系统有一个黑客可以利用的脆弱性。
words.en: The state of being exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally.

words.tr:
v. 伪造；假装；冒充；
adj. 假的；冒充的；伪造的；
words.ex: He faked a signature to get the money.
words.ex_cn: 他伪造了一个签名来拿到钱。
words.en: If something is fake, it is not real, genuine, or true, but is made to appear so.

words.tr: v. 描述…的特性；以…为特征；
words.ex: This book characterizes the hero as brave and kind.
words.ex_cn: 这本书将主人公描述为勇敢而善良的。
words.en: To describe the character or qualities of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 幸事； v. “bless”的现在分词；
words.ex: Finding a good job after graduation was a blessing.
words.ex_cn: 毕业后找到一份好工作是一件幸事。
words.en: A blessing is a prayer asking for God's favor and protection, or a beneficial thing for which one is grateful.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏足够教育的；贫穷的； v. 剥夺；使丧失；“deprive”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Children from deprived areas often struggle to read and write.
words.ex_cn: 来自教育缺乏地区的儿童常常难以阅读和写作。
words.en: If you are deprived of something that you want or need, you do not have it.

words.tr: n. 藤；藤蔓；藤本植物；葡萄藤；
words.ex: The grapes grow on a vine.
words.ex_cn: 葡萄长在藤上。
words.en: A vine is a plant that climbs up or along a support, such as a wall or trellis, and produces fruit or flowers.

words.ex: He caught a big bass in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他在湖里钓到了一条大鲈鱼。
words.en: The lowest adult male singing voice; or the musical part that is the lowest in pitch.

words.tr:
v. 引起（问题、危险等）；提出；
n. 姿势；
words.ex: Pollution can pose a serious threat to health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对健康造成严重威胁。
words.en: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you. / To pose a question or problem means to ask it or to present it.

words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.ex: The floor was filthy after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨过后，地板变得非常肮脏。
words.en: Something that is filthy is extremely dirty.

words.ex: The country made a declaration of independence.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家发表了独立宣言。
words.en: A declaration is a formal statement or announcement.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.ex: The transformation of the old factory into a park made the city nicer.
words.ex_cn: 把旧工厂改造成公园让城市变得更美了。
words.en: A transformation is a complete change in the appearance, form, or nature of something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 难以想象的；不可思议的；难以置信的；
words.ex: It is unthinkable to leave a child alone in the car.
words.ex_cn: 把孩子单独留在车里是难以想象的。
words.en: If something is unthinkable, it cannot be imagined or considered because it is so bad, impossible, or unlikely to happen.

words.ex: He contradicts what she said.
words.ex_cn: 他反驳了她的话。
words.en: If you contradict someone, you say that what they have just said is wrong, or you suggest that it is wrong by saying something different.

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

words.ex: The university has great prestige for its research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学因其研究而享有很高的声望。
words.en: The widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.

words.ex: You must believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你必须相信自己。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when the subject is 'one' and the same person is referred to.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.ex: The walker enjoys a daily walk in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位步行者喜欢每天在公园散步。
words.en: A person who walks, especially for exercise or enjoyment.

words.ex: She blesses her children every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上为孩子们祝福。
words.en: If someone is blessed with a particular good quality or skill, they have that good quality or skill.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.ex: His monthly expenses are too high.
words.ex_cn: 他的月支出太高了。
words.en: Expenses are the costs incurred in the process of doing something or the money spent on something.

words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.tr: adj. 工人阶级的；劳动阶级的
words.ex: He is a working-class boy who loves to read.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱阅读的工人阶级男孩。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of the working class; of or relating to the group of people in society who do not have a lot of money and who do manual or industrial work.

words.ex: The company gave sponsorship to the local sports team.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司资助了当地的体育团队。
words.en: The support given by a sponsor; the act of sponsoring.

words.tr: adj. 受欢呼的；受赞誉的； v. “acclaim”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The acclaimed actor received a standing ovation.
words.ex_cn: 这位受欢呼的演员赢得了起立鼓掌。
words.en: Publicly praised; celebrated.

words.ex: The teacher gave timely help when I was stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当我遇到困难时，老师及时提供了帮助。
words.en: done or occurring at a favorable or useful time; opportune.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.ex: The worker had long exposure to loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 这名工人长期暴露在噪音中。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to something, especially to something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.ex: He tries to restrain his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他努力克制自己的愤怒。
words.en: If you restrain someone, you stop them from doing what they intended or wanted to do, usually by using your physical strength.

words.ex: The company is bankrupt after losing all its money.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司失去所有钱后破产了。
words.en: If a person or a company is bankrupt, they have been declared by a court of law to be unable to pay their debts.

words.tr: v. 从事于；（使）参与；“engage”的现在分词； adj. 有趣的；
words.ex: He is engaging in community service.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从事社区服务。
words.en: An engaging person or thing is pleasant, interesting, and entertaining.

words.ex: Free lunch is a perk of this job.
words.ex_cn: 免费午餐是这份工作的一个额外补贴。
words.en: If someone perks up or if something perks them up, they become more cheerful or lively.

words.tr:
v. 推翻；颠覆；打倒
n. 推翻；颠覆；打倒
words.ex: The court will overturn the old law.
words.ex_cn: 法院将推翻这项旧法律。
words.en: If a decision, result, etc. is overturned, it is officially changed so that it becomes the opposite of what it was before.

words.ex: I cannot foresee what will happen tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我无法预知明天会发生什么。
words.en: If you foresee something, you expect and believe that it will happen.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.ex: He always follows his morality in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他日常生活中总是遵循自己的道德。
words.en: Morality is the belief that some behaviour is right and acceptable and that other behaviour is wrong.

words.ex: He decided to discard his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他决定抛开旧习惯。
words.en: To discard something means to get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

words.tr: n. 采矿；采矿业； v. “mine”的现在分词；
words.ex: Mining is an important industry in this region.
words.ex_cn: 采矿是这个地区的重要产业。
words.en: Mining is the process of extracting minerals and other materials from the earth.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish or command.

words.ex: The loud noise was an annoyance to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 那阵噪音让每个人都感到烦恼。
words.en: Annoyance is the feeling of being slightly angry or impatient.

words.ex: The riot broke out after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后爆发了骚乱。
words.en: A riot is a violent disturbance of the peace by a crowd.

words.tr: n. 不准确；不精确；错误
words.ex: The inaccuracy of the clock caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 钟的不准确导致了延误。
words.en: The quality or state of being inaccurate; error.

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.ex: He accepted liability for the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了事故的责任。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a liability, you mean that they cause a lot of problems or embarrassment.

words.tr: n. 参与人（数）；装束；产量；清理
words.ex: The turnout for the election was very high.
words.ex_cn: 这次选举的投票率很高。
words.en: The number of people attending or participating in an event, especially a political meeting or election.

words.tr: adj. 所得报酬过低的，酬不抵劳的; v. 给……报酬过低，少付……工资（underpay 的过去...
words.ex: He is underpaid for his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他工作努力却报酬太低。
words.en: If you are underpaid, you are paid less money for the work you do than you deserve.

words.ex: He bought a gallon of milk from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店买了一加仑牛奶。
words.en: A gallon is a unit of measurement for liquids that is equal to eight pints. In Britain, it is equal to about 4.546 litres. In America, it is equal to about 3.785 litres.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.tr: adj. 很长的；漫长的；冗长的；
words.ex: The meeting was lengthy and tiring.
words.ex_cn: 会议很长，很累人。
words.en: Something that is lengthy lasts for a long time, often longer than you want or expect.

words.ex: He will sue the company for damages.
words.ex_cn: 他将起诉这家公司要求赔偿。
words.en: To sue means to start a legal case against someone, usually to claim money from them because they have caused you harm or loss.

words.ex: He bought a new auto last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一辆新车。
words.en: A car; something that operates automatically.

words.ex: There's no need to make a fuss about a small mistake.
words.ex_cn: 一个小错误没必要大惊小怪。
words.en: If you make a fuss or kick up a fuss about something, you become angry or excited about it and complain.

words.ex: He paints on a canvas with oil colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用油画颜料在帆布上作画。
words.en: A strong, coarse unbleached cloth made from hemp, flax, cotton, or a similar yarn, used to make items such as sails and tents and as a surface for oil painting.

words.tr:
n. 卖淫者；娼妓；妓女；男妓
v. 卖淫；出卖（名誉等）；糟蹋自己；滥用才能
words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: A prostitute is someone who engages in sexual activity for payment.

words.ex: They will renovate the old house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月将翻新那栋老房子。
words.en: To renovate means to restore something to a good state of repair or to make it as good as new.

words.ex: The teacher changed the parameter to make the test easier.
words.ex_cn: 老师更改了参数，使测试更容易。
words.en: A parameter is a limit or boundary which defines the scope of a particular process or activity.

words.ex: His shyness made it hard to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他的害羞让他难以在全班面前说话。
words.en: Shyness is the feeling of being nervous or embarrassed in social situations, especially when meeting new people.

words.ex: She is wearing a black stocking.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一只黑色长筒袜。
words.en: A stocking is a piece of clothing which fits closely over the foot and is worn up to the knee or higher. Stockings are usually made of nylon or silk and are worn by women.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.ex: The fireworks at night were a beautiful spectacle.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的烟花是一场美丽的奇观。
words.en: A spectacle is a visually striking performance or display.

words.ex: The commissioner ordered the police to stop the protest.
words.ex_cn: 长官命令警察制止抗议活动。
words.en: A commissioner is an official in charge of a government department or a public organization, especially in the UK.

words.ex: He is knowledgeable about history and science.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史和科学都很博学。
words.en: Someone who is knowledgeable has or shows a clear understanding of many different facts about the world or about a particular subject.

words.tr: adj. 手提式的，便携式的
words.ex: He uses a hand-held camera to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他用手持相机拍照。
words.en: A hand-held device is a piece of electronic equipment that you can hold in your hands and use, such as a mobile phone or a tablet.

words.tr: adj. 不受个人感情影响的；没有人情味的；
words.ex: The judge gave an impersonal decision based on the law.
words.ex_cn: 法官基于法律作出了不受个人感情影响的判决。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as impersonal, you mean that they do not show any emotion about the person they are dealing with.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.ex: He publicly apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他公开为自己的错误道歉。
words.en: In a way that is open or visible to the public; not privately.

words.tr: adj. 强制的；法定的；义务的；
words.ex: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是强制的。
words.en: If something is mandatory, it is required by law or by a rule or regulation.

words.ex: The class analyzed statistical data from the survey.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级分析了调查的统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the use of statistics or statistical methods.

words.ex: Technically, the phone works, but it's slow.
words.ex_cn: 技术上讲，这部手机能用，但很慢。
words.en: In a way that relates to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry.

words.ex: The argument started small but soon escalate.
words.ex_cn: 争论起初很小，但很快逐步升高。
words.en: If a bad situation escalates or if someone or something escalates it, it becomes greater in size, seriousness, or intensity.

words.tr: n. 局外人；无取胜希望者；
words.ex: He felt like an outsider at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上感觉像个局外人。
words.en: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.ex: The educator helps students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 这位教育者帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: An educator is a person who educates people, especially as a job.

words.ex: He inserts a coin into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他把一枚硬币放进机器里。
words.en: To put or introduce something into something else.

words.tr: n. 烟雾；烟气；“fume”的复数； v. 大为生气；
words.ex: The car released black fumes from its exhaust.
words.ex_cn: 汽车从排气管冒出黑烟。
words.en: Fumes are the strong, often unpleasant smell or smoke that is given off by a substance.

words.ex: The kitchen has a new washing appliance.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有一台新的洗衣机。
words.en: An appliance is a device or machine that is used to perform a particular task, especially in the home.

words.ex: The alteration of the dress made it fit better.
words.ex_cn: 这件衣服的修改让它更合身了。
words.en: An alteration is a change in or to something.

words.ex: He is an adviser to the government.
words.ex_cn: 他是政府的顾问。
words.en: An adviser is a person who gives advice, especially someone who knows a lot about a particular subject.

words.ex: The courageous firefighter saved the child from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从着火的房子里救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is courageous shows courage.

words.ex: He has a dual role as teacher and coach.
words.ex_cn: 他同时担任老师和教练的双重角色。
words.en: Having two parts or aspects.

words.ex: The loud noise scared the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something scares you, it frightens or worries you.

words.tr:
v. 交换；
n. 交换；
words.ex: They swap books every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周交换书籍。
words.en: If you swap something with someone, you give it to them and receive a different thing in exchange.

words.tr: adv. 无论什么；任何(用于否定句中以加强语气)；
words.ex: You can eat whatever food whatsoever.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何食物。
words.en: used to emphasize a negative statement

words.tr: n. 偷窃，骗取; 敲诈行为; 索要高价
words.ex: That store sold me a fake watch for $50—it was a total rip-off.
words.ex_cn: 那家店卖给我一块假手表，花了50美元——真是个骗局。
words.en: A rip-off is something that is not worth what you pay for it, or someone who charges too much for something.

words.ex: The rule applies broadly across all schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个规定广泛适用于所有学校。
words.en: In a general way; without considering details.

words.ex: The removal of the old tree made the yard bigger.
words.ex_cn: 移除那棵老树让院子变大了。
words.en: The act of removing something or someone from a place or position.

words.tr:
n. 不尊敬；无礼；轻蔑
v. 不尊重
words.ex: He showed disrespect to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师表现出不尊重。
words.en: If someone shows disrespect, they speak or behave in a way that shows lack of respect for someone or something.

words.ex: The virus can infect people quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒能迅速感染人。
words.en: To infect someone or something means to cause them to have a disease or illness.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.ex: He gave a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地道歉了。
words.en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 选择性的；精挑细选的；
words.ex: He is selective about what he eats.
words.ex_cn: 他对吃的东西很挑剔。
words.en: If you are selective, you choose things carefully, for example, the things that you buy or do.

words.tr: adj. 令人信服的；有说服力的； v. 说服；“convince”的现在分词；
words.ex: His argument was convincing.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点令人信服。
words.en: A convincing argument, evidence, or person is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.tr: v. “say”的现在分词；说； n. 谚语；警句；
words.ex: He is saying goodbye to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向朋友们道别。
words.en: A short, well-known expression that states a general truth or gives advice.

words.ex: He tried to conceal the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图隐藏真相。
words.en: If you conceal something, you prevent it from being seen or known about.

words.tr:
n. 马鞍；鞍座
v. 给（马）装鞍
words.ex: The boy rode on a saddle on the horse.
words.ex_cn: 男孩骑在马的马鞍上。
words.en: A saddle is a seat for a rider on the back of a horse or other animal, or a similar seat on a bicycle or motorcycle. It can also refer to the act of putting a saddle on a horse or to burden someone with a responsibility.

words.ex: The revival of traditional music brought joy to many people.
words.ex_cn: 传统音乐的复兴给许多人带来了快乐。
words.en: The process of something becoming popular or active again after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: The data shows normality after the transformation.
words.ex_cn: 经过转换后，数据呈现出正态性。
words.en: Normality is a situation in which everything is normal.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.ex: He tried to seduce her with flowers and gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用鲜花和礼物引诱她。
words.en: To seduce someone means to persuade them to do something, especially something wrong or unwise, by making it seem attractive or exciting.

words.ex: The king's riches came from gold and land.
words.ex_cn: 国王的财富来自黄金和土地。
words.en: Riches refer to a large amount of money or valuable possessions.

words.ex: The simplification of the equation made it easier to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程的简化使它更容易求解。
words.en: The process of making something easier to do or understand, or the thing that results from this process.

words.tr: n. 代理；副职；恶习；缺点；
words.ex: He acted as vice for the manager during her absence.
words.ex_cn: 在经理缺席期间，他担任代理。
words.en: A vice is a moral fault or weakness in someone's character.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.tr: adj. 不合意的；不想要的；
words.ex: The weather is undesirable for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 这种天气不适合野餐。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as undesirable, you think they will have harmful effects or cause problems.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.tr:
v. 吸引；诱惑；引诱
n. 诱惑；诱饵；吸引力
words.ex: The bright colors lure the birds to the feeder.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引鸟类来到喂食器。
words.en: If you lure someone, you tempt them to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.

words.ex: His deception fooled everyone at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他的欺骗骗过了派对上的所有人。
words.en: Deception is the act of deceiving someone or the state of being deceived.

words.tr: adj. 务实的；实事求是的；
words.ex: He took a pragmatic approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了务实的方法来解决问题。
words.en: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

words.ex: The splendor of the sunset amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 日落的壮丽让每个人都惊叹。
words.en: Splendor is the great beauty or impressive appearance of something.

words.ex: The army launched a missile at the target.
words.ex_cn: 军队向目标发射了一枚导弹。
words.en: A missile is a weapon that is sent through the air and that explodes when it hits the thing it is aimed at.

words.tr: adj. 玫瑰色的；红润的（皮肤）；美好的；有希望的（前途等）
words.ex: The sky turned rosy at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 日出时，天空变成了玫瑰色。
words.en: If you describe a situation as rosy, you mean that it seems to be full of hope and promise.

words.ex: He answered the question with tact.
words.ex_cn: 他机智地回答了这个问题。
words.en: If you describe what someone says or does as tact, you mean that it is polite, considerate, and shows an understanding of other people's feelings.

words.ex: He subconsciously picked up his pencil when he thought.
words.ex_cn: 当他思考时，他下意识地拿起了铅笔。
words.en: If you do something subconsciously, you do it without realizing that you are doing it.

words.tr: adj. 羞辱性的；丢脸的； v. “humiliate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The humiliating comment made him feel small.
words.ex_cn: 那句羞辱性的话让他感到自己很渺小。
words.en: If something is humiliating, it makes you feel ashamed and stupid, often because it involves a loss of respect or dignity in front of other people.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.ex: He succumbed to the illness after a long fight.
words.ex_cn: 经过长期抗争后，他最终死于疾病。
words.en: If you succumb to temptation, pressure, or something such as an illness, you do something that you want to do, or you give in to the pressure or illness, often after a period of trying not to.

words.ex: The obscene behavior shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这种可憎的行为让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: If you describe something as obscene, you mean it offends you because it relates to sex or violence in a way that you think is unpleasant and shocking.

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.ex: The medicine helps reduce inhibition of the immune system.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制免疫系统的抑制。
words.en: Inhibition is a feeling that makes one self-conscious and unable to act in a relaxed and natural way.

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；
words.ex: His answer was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

words.ex: His denial of the mistake made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他否认错误，让所有人都生气了。
words.en: A denial is a statement that something is not true or does not exist.

words.ex: He sat by the window to ponder his future.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边深思自己的未来。
words.en: If you ponder something, you think about it carefully.

words.ex: The baby suck milk from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿从奶瓶里吮吸牛奶。
words.en: To draw something into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.ex: He felt guilt for his sin of lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因撒谎的罪行感到内疚。
words.en: Sin is an action or behaviour that is considered to be morally wrong according to religious or social laws.

words.ex: His conception of the new app was simple but clever.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新应用的构想简单而巧妙。
words.en: A conception is an idea or a plan that someone has in their mind.

words.ex: He follows the orthodox religious practices.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循正统的宗教习俗。
words.en: Orthodox beliefs, methods, or systems are ones which are accepted or used by most people.

words.ex: Hiking up the mountain was a strenuous task.
words.ex_cn: 爬山是一项艰苦的任务。
words.en: Requiring or using great effort or exertion.

words.tr: adj. 决定性的；权威性的；确定的；
words.ex: The test results were definitive.
words.ex_cn: 这些检测结果是决定性的。
words.en: A definitive book, performance, or report is considered to be the best of its kind that has ever been done or that will ever be done.

words.ex: He amended the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送信件之前修正了它。
words.en: To amend something means to make changes to it in order to improve it or make it more accurate.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr:
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水
n. 唾沫；一块陆地；烤肉叉
words.ex: He likes to spit watermelon seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吐西瓜籽。
words.en: To spit means to force out the contents of the mouth, especially saliva, through the lips. It can also refer to the act of ejecting saliva or phlegm from the mouth, often as a gesture of contempt or disrespect.

words.ex: The donor gave money to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 捐赠者向医院捐了钱。
words.en: A donor is a person or organization that gives something, especially money, to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: Children show dependence on their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对父母有依赖。
words.en: The state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.ex: The boy defied his parents by staying out late.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为熬夜不回家而违抗了父母。
words.en: If you defy someone or something, you refuse to obey them or you do something that they do not allow.

words.ex: The company made fraudulent claims about its product.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司对其产品做出了欺诈性的声明。
words.en: A fraudulent activity is deceitful or dishonest.

words.ex: The inequality between rich and poor is growing.
words.ex_cn: 贫富之间的不平等正在加剧。
words.en: Inequality refers to the unfair situation in society when some people have more opportunities, money, etc. than other people.

words.ex: The bike ride is easy because it is downhill.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车很容易，因为是下山的。
words.en: If something or someone is moving downhill or is downhill, they are moving down a slope or are towards the bottom of a hill.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.ex: The news saddened her.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让她感到悲伤。
words.en: If something saddens you, it makes you feel sad.

words.ex: The two countries made a pact to stop fighting.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家达成了一项停止战斗的协议。
words.en: A pact is a formal agreement between two or more people, organizations, or governments to do a particular thing or to help each other.

words.ex: The judge will uphold the law.
words.ex_cn: 法官将维护法律。
words.en: If you uphold something such as a law, a principle, or a decision, you support and maintain it.

words.ex: He knowingly broke the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他有意地违反了规则。
words.en: If you do something knowingly, you do it in a way that shows you understand what is happening or what the situation is.

words.tr:
n. 针脚；缝线；一针
v. 缝；缝合
words.ex: She sews a stitch to fix the tear.
words.ex_cn: 她缝一针来补破洞。
words.en: A stitch is a piece of thread that has been used to sew the edges of a wound together. It can also refer to a loop of thread or yarn resulting from a single pass or movement of the needle in sewing, knitting, or crocheting.

words.ex: The tree has a hollow trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干是中空的。
words.en: If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.

words.tr: adj. 令人怜悯的；使人同情的；可怜的
words.ex: The dog looked pitiful in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那只狗在雨中看起来很可怜。
words.en: If you describe something as pitiful, you mean that it is inadequate or disappointing.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.ex: The outbreak of the flu surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 流感的爆发让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An outbreak of something unpleasant, such as violence or a disease, is a sudden occurrence of it.

words.ex: She is assertive when she speaks up for her rights.
words.ex_cn: 当她为自己权利发声时，表现得坚定自信。
words.en: Someone who is assertive behaves confidently and is not frightened to say what they want or believe.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.tr:
n. 鞭策；
v. 刺激；
words.ex: The competition served as a spur to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 竞争成了推动他更努力工作的鞭策。
words.en: A spur is something that makes you want to do something or that encourages you to do it. It can also refer to a sharp device worn on the heel of a rider's boot to urge a horse forward.

words.ex: It was an utter mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个完全的错误。
words.en: To say something or to make a sound with your voice; complete or absolute.

words.ex: It is inconceivable that he forgot his own birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了自己生日，这简直难以想象。
words.en: If something is inconceivable, it is impossible to imagine or believe because it is so unlikely.

words.ex: The children are playing on the grounds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在操场上玩耍。
words.en: Grounds can refer to the land surrounding a large building, such as a school or a hospital, or the reasons or justifications for a particular action or belief.

words.tr: adj. 种族主义的；种族歧视的；
words.ex: He made a racist comment about immigrants.
words.ex_cn: 他对移民发表了种族主义的言论。
words.en: A racist is someone who believes that people of their own race are superior to those of other races and who behaves in a way that shows this belief.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.tr:
v. 责备；指责
n. 责备；指责
words.ex: She reproached him for being late.
words.ex_cn: 她责备他迟到了。
words.en: To express disapproval or disappointment towards someone because of their actions or behavior.

words.tr: adj. 可辩解的；可证明为正当的；有理的
words.ex: His action was justifiable because he protected his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为是合理的，因为他保护了他的朋友。
words.en: If something is justifiable, there is a good reason for it.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.tr:
n. 韵文；
v. 押韵；
words.ex: The poem has a simple rhyme.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗有一段简单的韵文。
words.en: A rhyme is a repetition of similar sounds in the final stressed syllables and any following syllables of two or more words, most often used in poetry.

words.tr:
v. 集合起来；振作；复苏
n. 集会
words.ex: The crowd rallied to support their team.
words.ex_cn: 人群聚集起来支持他们的球队。
words.en: A rally is a large public meeting that is held in order to show support for something such as a political party or a sports team. It can also mean to come together again in order to continue fighting or arguing after a defeat or a period of confusion.

words.tr: v. 追溯到；“date”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 过时的；陈旧的；
words.ex: This coin is dated to the year 1500.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币追溯到1500年。
words.en: Something that is dated is old-fashioned and no longer relevant or useful.

words.ex: The narrator told the story in a calm voice.
words.ex_cn: 叙述者用平静的声音讲述了这个故事。
words.en: A narrator is a person who tells a story, or a person who speaks during a film or television program not as an actor but to describe or discuss the pictures being shown.

words.ex: This plan is viable and can be done with little money.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且用很少的钱就能完成。
words.en: If something is viable, it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

words.ex: The eventual winner was a young student.
words.ex_cn: 最后的赢家是一位年轻学生。
words.en: An eventual event or situation happens at the end of a process or period of time.

words.ex: The police found a corpse near the river.
words.ex_cn: 警察在河边发现了一具尸体。
words.en: A corpse is a dead body, especially the dead body of a human.

words.ex: He scarcely ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃任何东西。
words.en: You use scarcely to emphasize that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.ex: The tribal people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 部落的人住在森林里。
words.en: Tribal relates to a tribe or tribes.

words.ex: The skull protects the brain.
words.ex_cn: 颅骨保护大脑。
words.en: The bony framework of the head that encloses the brain and supports the structures of the face.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He consistently arrives at school on time.
words.ex_cn: 他一贯准时到校。
words.en: In a way that does not vary; in the same way over time.

words.ex: He is a renowned scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有名的科学家。
words.en: Known or talked about by many people; famous.

words.tr: adv. 全心全意地；一心一意地；
words.ex: She supported her friend wholeheartedly.
words.ex_cn: 她全心全意地支持她的朋友。
words.en: If you do something wholeheartedly, you do it with all your heart and soul, without holding back.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.tr: n. 揭露；被揭示的真相；
words.ex: The letter was a revelation about his secret life.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他隐秘的生活。
words.en: A revelation is a surprising and previously unknown fact that has been disclosed to others.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: The storm will intensify tonight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴今晚会加强。
words.en: To make or become more intense or intensive.

words.ex: The observer recorded the weather every day.
words.ex_cn: 观测者每天记录天气。
words.en: An observer is someone who sees or notices something, or who watches something carefully.

words.ex: He handed in his resignation last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周递交了辞职信。
words.en: The act of giving up a job or position in a formal or official way; also refers to the acceptance of something undesirable but inevitable.

words.ex: He violated the school rule by using his phone in class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课使用手机，违反了校规。
words.en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

words.tr: adj. 繁荣的；旺盛的；兴旺的； v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；“thrive”的现在分词；
words.ex: The town is thriving because of its new factories.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇因为新的工厂而繁荣。
words.en: Prospering or flourishing; successful.

words.ex: The prosecution brought evidence against the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 起诉方提供了针对嫌疑人的证据。
words.en: The act or process of holding a trial against a person who is accused of a crime to see if they are guilty.

words.ex: The proximity of the school to the park makes it nice for kids.
words.ex_cn: 学校靠近公园，对孩子们来说很好。
words.en: Proximity refers to the state of being near in space or time.

words.ex: He cares only about money and things, showing strong materialism.
words.ex_cn: 他只关心金钱和物质，表现出强烈的实利主义。
words.en: Materialism is the belief that only physical matter exists, and that everything, including thought, feeling, mind, and will, can be explained in terms of matter and physical phenomena.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；怀疑的；拿不准的；
words.ex: The deal seemed dubious to me.
words.ex_cn: 这个交易在我看来很可疑。
words.en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

words.ex: He is irritable when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候容易烦躁。
words.en: If someone is irritable, they are easily annoyed.

words.tr: v. 侵蚀；腐蚀；逐渐丧失；削弱
words.ex: The wind erodes the sand slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢侵蚀着沙子。
words.en: If rock or soil erodes or is eroded by the weather, sea, or wind, it cracks and breaks so that it is gradually destroyed.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.ex: He enjoys recreational activities like swimming and hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动。
words.en: Relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: He had a flashback to his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他突然想起了自己的童年。
words.en: A flashback is a scene in a movie, novel, etc., set in a time earlier than the main story.

words.tr: n. 前任；前辈；原有事物
words.ex: He became the new manager, replacing his predecessor.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了新经理，接替了他的前任。
